observations.observation: meeting.actual_attendance duplicates the count of effective unique attended Persons. Finalization must retain an exact identity/revision snapshot, not a count as a substitute. Derived duration totals likewise do not need independent truth.

Invitation attribution and canonical RSVP can have one bounded artifact lifecycle when historical source meaning remains distinct. The product does not require an independent invitation tree or two current RSVP truths.

A separate relation row has its own actor-independent revision and timestamps although ordinary task edit and relation edit are one aggregate operation. The requirement needs integrity-enforced optional typed context, not necessarily a standalone lifecycle.

Several attributable append-only event shapes repeat actor, tenant, time and revision facts. A shared event mechanism may reduce repetition only if exact subject FKs and domain-specific immutable evidence remain enforced. Private check-in history cannot share the ordinary audit path.

A transition needs one durable accept/decline answer with its exact selected set and inserted IDs. One answer per template key is not the required uniqueness; transport cookies and separate competing import receipts add no capability.

Canonical actual Launch date/counts must not be copied into independently authoritative debrief answers. Submitted debrief and reviewed summary need immutable versions; simultaneous published text, version metadata and arbitrary typed event copies need one authoritative lineage.

Recipient state/delivery timestamps and communication-level totals must not compete with the single email ledger. A separately owned retry table is useful only if it adds required reviewed resend lineage not already represented by immutable request/operation identities.

Provider dispatch state belongs to email intents/attempts, while inbox entry owns read state only. Its generic resource_type/resource_id pair needs an enforced typed reference in the future design; a string discriminator alone does not prove tenant/target integrity.

Computed averages, agenda totals, countdowns, aggregate progress and provider recipient counts are query results unless a named snapshot consumer requires frozen evidence. Repeated generic updated/created/actor fields should survive only where ordering, concurrency or actual provenance uses them.

Private correction history is genuinely required, while trend strip and support question are derived from adjacent logical weeks. No separate score, nudge or outreach record is justified. Stable unanswered week identities and pending personal-zone transition are required even though an answers-only current row does not fully express them.
